description.en: The ID of the conditional access policy.

descriptions.zh: 您在删除指定条件访问策略时，请确保对应策略已经不再使用，策略删除后所有配置数据都将被删除，无法进行恢复。
descriptions.en: Before you delete a conditional access policy, make sure that the policy is no longer in use. After the policy is deleted, all configuration data is permanently removed and cannot be recovered.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eiam delete-conditional-access-policy --instance-id idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --conditional-access-policy-id cap_11111 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eiam DeleteConditionalAccessPolicy --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceId idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --ConditionalAccessPolicyId cap_11111
